attchmntText: CMR Green Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Sanction and Enhancement of credit facilities.
voiceSummary: CMR Green Technologies Limited has received a sanction letter from HDFC Bank Limited for credit facilities totaling Rs. 210 Crore. This includes Rs. 170 Crore in fund-based facilities and Rs. 40 Crore in non-fund-based facilities. The company also received a sanction letter from Axis Bank Limited for the renewal and enhancement of working capital facilities and a fresh Term Loan. The revised limit with Axis Bank is Rs. 274 Crore, comprising Rs. 217 Crore in working capital, Rs. 32 Crore in Term Loan, and Rs. 25 Crore in other facilities. These credit facilities are intended to strengthen the company's liquidity position and support business operations.

attchmntText: CMR Green Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: CMR Green Technologies Limited has made the audio recording of the earnings conference call available on its website. The call was held on Thursday, November 12, 2026. It discussed the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The recording is accessible at https://www.cmr.co.in/press-release/. This disclosure is pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company is CMR Green Technologies Limited. The registered office is in Faridabad, Haryana. The equity scrip code is CMRGREEN. The ISIN is INE00WV01027. The notice was issued by Srishti Saxena, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: CMR Green Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: CMR Green Technologies Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the second quarter and half of fiscal year 2026-27 ended on 30th September 2026. The company reported revenue of Rs. 3,471.9 crore for Q2 FY27, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 59.2%. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 72.6 crore, up 25.4% year-on-year. EBITDA reached Rs. 150.7 crore, showing a 30.5% increase. Sales volume grew 14.4% year-on-year to 1,19,959 metric tons. For the half-year, revenue was Rs. 6,594.6 crore, and PAT was Rs. 140.8 crore. The presentation is available on the company website at www.cmr.co.in.

attchmntText: CMR Green Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 07, 2026, titled "Publication of Financial Results for 2nd Quarter and Half Year ending on 30th September 2026".
voiceSummary: CMR Green Technologies Limited has published the extract of its approved un-audited Financial Results, covering both Consolidated and Standalone figures, for the Second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The announcement was filed with the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited on November 7, 2026. The financial results were published in the Financial Express in English and Jansatta in Hindi. The details are also available on the company website at https://www.cmr.co.in/. The filing was signed by Srishti Saxena, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.
